We got quite good start, and after the usual confusing first minutes we got the map under our control. Nothing special...ic tried, but the score can be explained, because this was ic's first clanwar ever. One of their players dropped in the middle of the game, and never came back. Bad to both teams. - Geuzer [ZR] === E1M2 === ZR: 327 - IC: 0

Round started... again good spawns to us. Soon [IC]Marvin noticed that he had troubles with skins... both teams were same color(?). And he left for a while to fix the problem... after 5 minutes he came back, but if I undertood right, it didn´t help. I think this round was fun for nobody... well, there is nothing special to tell about this game. IC needs practise, one day they will kick ass! Good Luck to IC's rest matches! - Geuzer [ZR] == Summary == * Score: 2-0 * Total frags **ZR: 653 **IC: 6 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
